  If you use Webflow, Whalesync will rock your world. It's the easiest way to keep things in sync and do things you'd never even thought of. We're in the process of moving 4-5 Webflow no-code automations over from Zapier. The simple UX and value are unmatched, the support is awesome, and they're adding connections all the time. We're using it for Airtable to Webflow sync and are about to request access to the Supabase connector soon. @mbusel and the Whalesync crew clearly understood our pain when they built this. Just don't forget us little folks when you become the next decacorn! 🦄 [...] I've been using Whalesync for ~6 months now, and I cannot sing its praises enough. I will speak to Airtable + Webflow in particular here, and why it's been so great for me - Whalesync has saved me a \significant\ amount of time on each by being able to sync my Airtable bases to my Webflow sites - Being able to sync 1 Airtable base to multiple Webflow sites has enabled me to spin up extremely SEO focused microsites (I filter the Airtable views based on the site itself). Both are revenue generating, and have covered all the costs of Whalesync - I have trust in the integrity of my data. I don't have to worry about "I updated Site A, do I need to update Site B?" - My SEO/Google Search Console rankings have shot to the moon.
